topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: The research child documented next step architecture in state.md and handoffs/tl_to_dev.md, while handoffs/resume_brief.md remained at intake to research.
The Research-Child may write state.md and handoffs/tl_to_dev.md, but cannot write resume_brief.md; the spawn-only Parent may not write phase artifacts.
The contract requires a stop when an existing resume brief is stale, not a silent fallback on state.md; RESUME_BRIEF_AUTO_REFRESH=0 prevents automatic repair.
AUTO_RESUME_ERROR RESUME_BRIEF_STALE must block a conflicting resume brief; no fallback or next spawn is permitted until valid boundary evidence exists.
The issue is an orchestration and permissions deadlock: Research is complete, but the mandatory Resume-Nachweis cannot be advanced, so architecture cannot start.

duplicate_check_notes: Distinct from BUG-0005, which covers a stale brief immediately after bug intake. This defect is a research-to-architecture phase-boundary ownership deadlock: the completed child and spawn-only parent have no authorized writer for the mandatory resume brief. Distinct from BUG-0034, which registers a PO closure token, and from US-0023/US-0048, which require rather than repair phase isolation.
decomposition_rationale: One vertical orchestration contract gap: a lawful completed phase cannot advance its paired resume evidence under the permission matrix, creating a permanent fail-closed deadlock.
